An editorial illustration features a man with black hair, brown skin, and a white, button-down shirt. He is leaning towards a white, human-shaped cutout. His left arm extends behind this blank silhouette, with his hand resting on its shoulder. The man has brown eyes, a straight nose, and thin lips. The silhouette is positioned in front of a blue, rounded-rectangular background. 

The word "TEMPO" is printed in large, black, serif capital letters at the top. Above it, black text reads "BAHAYA INVESTASI LIGWINA HANANTO" and "AWAS PREDATOR SEKS ANAK," separated by a thin, gray diagonal line. Below "TEMPO" is the date "21-27 APRIL 2014." In the bottom right corner, bold black text reads "WAKIL SEHIDUP SEMATI." The bottom left corner contains a price of "RP 35.000," a website address, "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN," an ISSN number, a barcode, and a numerical code. The composition is bordered on the left and bottom by a red frame. The overall background is an off-white gradient.
